database.workspacePollingHeadroomAtObservation: If each 30-second poll maps to one database operation, two continuously open tabs would add an estimated 172,800 operations per 30-day month, leaving about 2,836 of the 200,000 shared allowance after the observed 24,364; other application and workspace activity is additional. Four continuously open player tabs would exceed the allowance.
